profile.summary: The Bay Area Writing Project is a teacher-led program based at the University of California, Berkeley. It offers programs for teachers of writing at all grade levels and in all subjects, both on campus and in Bay Area schools. It has served educators since 1973 and is a site of the National Writing Project.
